countDefinitions.meshEntries: Captured mesh records; this is not a GPU draw count.
countDefinitions.renderInstances: Sum of retained world/instance placements in the captured source geometry.
countDefinitions.uniqueGeometryCount: Identical captured positions, indices and normals are deduplicated; this counts distinct source streams.
countDefinitions.uniqueAuthoredVertices: Vertices summed once per deduplicated source geometry, before repeated placements.
countDefinitions.uniqueAuthoredTriangles: Triangles summed once per deduplicated source geometry, before repeated placements.
countDefinitions.instancedAuthoredTriangles: Captured triangles multiplied by each retained placement. This excludes shadow/postprocess pass repetition and is not a native workload measurement.
countDefinitions.degenerateInstancedTriangles: Geometric zero-area triangle test multiplied by retained placements; this does not by itself establish invalid construction.
countDefinitions.missingNormalMeshEntries: Captured mesh records without a supplied normal stream. Presence is not a test of normal orientation, smoothness or lighting quality.
countDefinitions.bounds: Axis-aligned bounds over retained transformed source geometry; bounds alone do not establish solid volume or reference fidelity.

evidencedConstructionScope: Independent source review examined procedural primitive/baked mesh positions, indices, normals and world/instance construction. Mechanical reconstruction retained source geometry and all placements. No source paths, APIs or implementation labels are provided here.
limitations: Exact position-stream matches correlate captured source streams with successful writes in native vertex buffers that were submitted. They do not by themselves prove index, shader or world-transform parity or final visibility.
No watertightness, self-intersection, normal-direction or interior-volume test is claimed by these aggregate counts.
Geometry density, deduplicated counts and repeated placement alone are not visual quality ratings. Use the unchanged rubric and all supplied views; disclose uncertainty.
